groups.name: zylos.security
groups.description: Configuration for the Zylos security starter.

properties.name: zylos.security.issuer-uri
properties.description: The exact iss value the realm publishes. Tokens with a different issuer are rejected.

properties.name: zylos.security.jwk-set-uri
properties.description: Optional direct JWKS (certs) endpoint used only to fetch signing keys, decoupled from issuer-uri. When set, the decoder fetches keys from here and skips OIDC discovery; iss validation still uses issuer-uri. Use in split-horizon topologies where in-cluster pods reach Keycloak at a different URL than the public issuer (e.g. internal Service :8080 vs a port-less ingress iss). When omitted, OIDC discovery via issuer-uri is used.

properties.name: zylos.security.expected-audience
properties.description: The aud claim value this service identifies as. No multi-audience tolerance.

properties.name: zylos.security.clock-skew
properties.description: Permissive window for exp/nbf validation. Default: 30s.

properties.name: zylos.security.jwks-cache.max-entries
properties.description: Maximum number of JWKS-cache entries. Default: 16.

properties.name: zylos.security.actor-chains.location
properties.description: Location of the actor-chains.yaml file. Default: classpath:actor-chains.yaml.

properties.name: zylos.security.opa.endpoint
properties.description: Base URL of the OPA server.

properties.name: zylos.security.opa.cache-ttl
properties.description: TTL for cached OPA decisions. Default: 30s.

properties.name: zylos.security.opa.cache-max-size
properties.description: Max entries in the OPA decision cache. Default: 50000.

properties.name: zylos.security.actor-chains.enabled
properties.description: Whether the actor-chains registry is loaded and the authorization manager is exposed. Defaults to true; set false to disable when the service has no chain requirements.

properties.name: zylos.security.opa.connect-timeout
properties.description: OPA HTTP client connect timeout. Default: 500ms.

properties.name: zylos.security.opa.read-timeout
properties.description: OPA HTTP client read timeout. Default: 1s.

properties.name: zylos.security.mdc.enabled
properties.description: Whether the MDC enrichment filter is registered. Default: true.

properties.name: zylos.security.mdc.correlation-id-header
properties.description: Request/response header name for the correlation ID. Default: X-Correlation-Id.
